page.overview:
Who is Curtis?

Lieutenant Curtis was a 24th century Starfleet command division officer who served as attaché to Vice Admiral Dougherty during the 2370s.

In 2375, she was placed in charge of the Ba'ku survey team for the duck blind mission on . When the blind was revealed to the Ba'ku, by a malfunctioning Data, Curtis and her crew were taken "hostage" by the inhabitants of the planet. ()
